scope: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B plus Qwen3-ForcedAligner CUDA compatibility on synthetic clear single-speaker English/German. Not a meeting accuracy, boundary accuracy, throughput, peak-VRAM, or NeMo/pyannote compatibility benchmark.

hardware.source: Read-only nvidia-smi observation supplied by the supervising agent. Total memory is not measured inference memory consumption.

launch.wrapper: GPU-sharing launcher at 85% of GPU threads

audio_generation: espeak-ng -v en-us -s 155 -w /tmp/sonefold-smoke/english.wav 'The meeting starts at nine. Alice will send the report on Friday. Bob will review the budget.'
espeak-ng -v de -s 150 -w /tmp/sonefold-smoke/german.wav 'Das Meeting beginnt um neun Uhr. Anna sendet den Bericht am Freitag. Ben prüft das Budget.'
reproduction.note: Run from the repository root with the recorded model revisions and runtime. Request device=cuda explicitly. The GPU-sharing launcher preserves desktop headroom.

runtime_console_diagnostics: Official Qwen generation configuration emitted an ignored-temperature flag notice; worker responses contained no alignment warnings.
